fetchTradingFee.description: swap trading fee from the account step rate

fetchPositionsHistory.description: closed isolated long position, positionType is an integer here (1 = cross, 2 = isolated) unlike position/list

fetchOpenOrders.description: open trailing orders are filtered locally by status since track-list returns entries in every state
